subject: Insurance
title: Credibility Theory
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Credibility Theory.

hook.text: Trust one person's claim history or the population's data? Credibility theory weighs both to set the right premium.

buildup.text: A driver with zero claims in 10 years looks safe. But statistically, anyone can have an accident.

discovery.text: Credibility theory assigns a weight: the more data points you have.

twist.text: New drivers get charged group rates because there's no personal data yet. After five claim-free years.

climax.text: Credibility theory is how insurers personalize premiums.

punchline.text: 0 claims in 10 years? Your data earns trust.

quiz.question: What does credibility theory determine?
options: How to weight individual data vs. group data for pricing
If a policy should be canceled
